final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT il.InvoiceId AS invoice_id, c.State AS state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.State), s2 AS (SELECT state, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1 GROUP BY state), s3 AS (SELECT a.invoice_id, a.state, a.cnt, 1.0 * a.cnt / b.total AS quotient FROM s1 a JOIN s2 b ON a.state = b.state), s4 AS (SELECT state, AVG(quotient) AS avg_q FROM s3 GROUP BY state) SELECT c.invoice_id, c.state, c.cnt, c.quotient, c.quotient - d.avg_q AS diff FROM s3 c JOIN s4 d ON c.state = d.state WHERE c.quotient > d.avg_q ORDER BY (c.quotient - d.avg_q) IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
